identifier.reasoning: Names the specific trait or variable being measured (e.g., log body mass).

Aversion to road Mean (SE).reasoning: Contains the mean value and its associated standard error for the trait.

Aversion to road t-statistic.reasoning: Represents the calculated t-statistic for the road aversion relationship.

p.reasoning: Represents the p-value associated with the statistical test.

Aversion to high lantana Mean (SE).reasoning: Contains the mean value and its associated standard error for the lantana aversion trait.

Aversion to high lantana t-statistic.reasoning: Represents the calculated t-statistic for the lantana aversion relationship.

Aversion to high lantana p.reasoning: Represents the p-value associated with the lantana aversion test.
